ir.name: usw_stratified_best_anchor_k16
ir.intuition: Keep the discovered USW loss but match BOPO's instance-local rank-stratified 15-edge anchor geometry at B=128 and K=16.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    pool_size = int(objective.shape[1])
    select_k = 16
    if select_k < 2 or pool_size % select_k != 0:
        raise ValueError('pool_size % select_k must be zero and select_k >= 2')
    order = torch.argsort(objective, dim=1, stable=True)
    stride = pool_size // select_k
    selected = order[:, ::stride]
    batch_size = int(objective.shape[0])
    b_idx = torch.arange(batch_size, device=objective.device)[:, None].expand(batch_size, select_k - 1).reshape(-1)
    winner_idx = selected[:, :1].expand(batch_size, select_k - 1).reshape(-1)
    loser_idx = selected[:, 1:].reshape(-1)
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'usw_stratified_best_anchor_k16', 'pair_scope': 'instance_local'})
